transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well, honestly, work sent me here. I'm a maintenance worker, and lately... I just keep forgetting things. I'll miss scheduled callbacks, forget about work orders, or just completely drop the ball on basic follow-ups I promised people. It's gotten really bad, and it's piled up so much that my boss basically told me I needed to get this sorted out before I lose my chance at a promotion.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless?

No, I haven't really been feeling down or depressed. I mean, I'm stressed about the promotion and messing up at work, but it's not like a sadness or hopelessness. Just... frustrated with myself, mostly.
Have you been drinking alcohol more than you used to?
No, not at all. I might have a beer on the weekend every now and then, but my drinking hasn't changed or gone up. That's definitely not the issue here.
Did you have problems with attention or forgetfulness as a child?

Yeah, actually, I did. I remember being exactly this way back in grade school, long before I had any of this pressure from work. My teachers always said I was bright, but... I was constantly misplacing my papers. I'd miss parts of the directions they gave us, and I always needed reminders just to finish my classwork. So, it's definitely not a new thing.
Did you have these same attention and forgetfulness problems outside of work, such as at home or in other parts of your life?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really noticed it as much at home. I mean, I mostly just see it at work because that's where it really causes problems for me, you know? But outside of my job... I don't really know.
Do you have these attention or forgetfulness problems at home too?

Like I said, I'm really not sure. I haven't noticed it causing issues at home the way it does at work. At home, there aren't as many deadlines or strict rules to follow, so if I forget something or lose track of what I'm doing, it's not a big deal. So, I don't know if it happens there or not.
Do these attention and forgetfulness problems happen in more than one setting, like both at work and at home?

I... well, I guess I really only notice it at work. Like I was just saying, work is where the pressure is, where I have to fix things on a schedule. At home... I just don't know. I don't really pay attention to whether I'm forgetting things there because it doesn't get me in trouble. So I can't say for sure if it happens in both places.
Outside of work, do these attention or forgetfulness problems ever cause you any real problems in your daily life?

No, not really. Like I was trying to explain, if I get distracted or forget something on my own time, there's no real fallout. I don't have a boss breathing down my neck at home, so if I leave a chore half-finished, it just waits until later. So... no, I don't have any examples of it actually messing up my personal life. It's really just my job where it's a big issue.
Do you also tend to be physically restless or fidgety when you’re trying to sit still?

No, I don't really have that problem. I mean, my job keeps me on my feet a lot anyway, but when I do sit down... I just sit. I don't get fidgety or feel like I have to be moving around. So, no, I wouldn't say that's an issue for me.
Do you find yourself feeling excessively worried or on edge most days?
No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I get frustrated with myself when I mess up on a job, but I don't walk around feeling worried or on edge most days. It's just not really something I deal with.
Do you have trouble paying attention or remembering things in settings other than work, such as at home or with friends?

I think I kind of just answered that, but no, not really. Like I said a minute ago, I might get distracted and leave a chore half done at home, but it doesn't really affect anything. With friends or just on my own time, I don't really notice it being an issue. It's really just at work where it's a problem.
Before these work problems, did you have similar trouble paying attention or following through as a child?

Yeah, I actually remember being this way back in grade school. It was long before any of the pressure I have at my job now. My teachers used to say I was bright, but I was always misplacing my papers or missing parts of the directions. They constantly had to give me reminders just to finish my classwork. So, yeah, I did have similar trouble back then.
